application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and retained proof hashes preserved.
Permutation invariance uses an explicit equivalence of direction tuples and a bijection of finite vertex sets. No replacement probability law is introduced.
The vertex sum and product are reindexed exactly; face-copy equivariance is verified for both insert and erase operations.
An actual swap sends coordinate zero to any prescribed coordinate. The existing first-coordinate inequalities transfer along the verified invariance.
Zero-dimensional statements with a selected coordinate are eliminated using the impossibility of an element of Fin 0; no unsupported nonempty-coordinate assumption is added.
Four theorems are individually audited. Full multidimensional iteration and the high-order concatenation, Bessel and inverse gaps remain unproved.
remaining: The common-system master estimates, first-order Bessel, dual energy reduction, recursion and stability are proved. Actual dual functions now have a common finite empirical approximation preserving arbitrary cell probabilities, unit bounds and uniform bounded-test correlations. Exact arbitrary-vertex reflection of the actual subgroup cube law and mixed products is now proved. Mixed cubes now have exact arbitrary-vertex duality and weighted single-vertex replacement estimates. Finite products of dual functions now have quantitative empirical approximation uniform over bounded tests. Exact translated-product expansions and extraction for each fixed test are now proved. The exact mixed face split, projected-face correlation and one-step face Cauchy-Schwarz inequality are now proved. Face energies are now identified with actual copied cube means, with nonnegativity and copy algebra verified. Arbitrary-coordinate permutation invariance, copied-mean nonnegativity and reflection bounds are now established. Full multidimensional iteration and higher-order concatenation controlling dual correlations and the full qualitative Bessel theorem remain missing, as do remaining replica integration, cyclic-to-interval transfer and inverse correlator existence. Coloring-derived targets, Calibration/Alignment and final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remain. StrongConjecture is unchanged and unproved. No unavoidable blocker is established; publication, PR and prize application remain pending.
